description: This file defines data models and default settings for a range chart widget in a dashboard application, including interfaces, default configurations, and utility functions for processing range items and chart settings.

classes.name: RangeItem
classes.description: Represents a range segment with associated visual and label properties for the chart.

classes.name: RangeChartWidgetSettings
classes.description: Configuration settings for the range chart widget, including visual options, thresholds, axes, and legend settings.

methods.name: rangeChartDefaultSettings
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the range chart widget.

methods.name: rangeChartTimeSeriesSettings
methods.description: Generates chart time series settings based on widget configuration, range items, decimal precision, and units.

methods.name: rangeChartTimeSeriesKeySettings
methods.description: Creates key settings for the chart series based on widget configuration.

methods.name: toRangeItems
methods.description: Converts color ranges into chart range items with visual map pieces and labels.
